title: Binary truncated inverse-difference parallelogram identity
statement: Let ell>=1 and R=GF(2)[x]/(x^(ell+1)). For a unit f and zero-constant h,t, put delta_h(f)=f^(-1)+(f+h)^(-1). Then delta_h(f)=delta_h(f+t) if and only if h t(t+h)=0 in R.

evidence.supports: The denominator-clearing derivation and both sides of the quotient-ring equivalence, with the noncancellable h factor retained.
evidence.notes: The test exhausts every packed f,h,t through ell=6 and includes a modulo-x^4 mutation witness that fails if h is cancelled. The universal proof is the two-line denominator-clearing identity recorded in ADR-0562; exhaustive rows are controls, not the quantifier step.

provenance.source: direct algebra in the truncated characteristic-two polynomial ring

notes: This identity classifies equality inside an inverse-difference fibre. It does not determine the sign of the resulting four-shift Mobius correlation and supplies no endpoint theorem credit by itself.
